milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate close enough to the melon cluster (centered at spawn-relative ~4.5, 0, ~3.5) and be facing toward it, modeling that they can visually observe the melons. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable viewing distance, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the melons.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate close enough to the dark oak tree canopy (centered at spawn-relative ~9.5, 3, ~8) and be facing toward it. max_distance=10 is used (tighter than default 16) to ensure the player has moved past the melon area toward the tree before this triggers, enforcing the dependency chain.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The target blocks are at spawn-relative (~9.5, 0, ~12), hidden behind the dark oak leaf wall at z=9-10. max_distance=8 is used (tighter) to ensure the player has navigated past/around the tree to the far side where the target is visible. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the target blocks.
